name: Bukchon Hanok Village
description: A hillside grid of restored hanok between Gyeongbokgung and Changdeokgung, still lived-in rather than staged. Come early — before 10:00 the lanes are quiet and the rooftops line up cleanly against the palace walls. Residents ask visitors to keep their voices down.

name: Dalmaji Hill
description: The wooded ridge above Haeundae Beach, with a coastal walking path (Moontan Road) that threads through pines and cafés with floor-to-ceiling sea views. The name means "moon greeting" — it's a locals' spot for the first full moon of the year.

name: Leeum Museum of Art
description: Three buildings by Mario Botta, Jean Nouvel and Rem Koolhaas holding both Korean traditional art (celadon, folk painting, gold) and a strong contemporary collection. The permanent galleries are free; book a timed slot online for weekends.
